verdict.rationale: LibreOffice's documented CLI converts many files in one run: the example `--convert-to pdf:writer_pdf_Export --outdir /home/user *.doc` passes a glob of files to a single headless invocation. A community user also confirms running it in Docker to normalize document formats. Nothing in the evidence documents per-file results, such as success/failure status, an exit report or a log per file. missing for 10: per-file result/status reporting, documented handling of failures within a batch, explicit folder/recursive input support beyond shell globs.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can convert a whole folder or list of files in one run, with per-file results

citations.quote: Also runs it in Docker to generate PDFs from templates and normalize document formats.
